notes.title: 0.4.1 Bug Fixes
notes.content: Fix for tower prices not showing up

notes.title: UI 2.0!
notes.content: The first of many major updates, this one focused on improving the look and feel of the game to appear much more polished and professional.

notes.title: 0.3.0 Week 3 Update - Sovereign Reign Enabled, last week of focused bug fixing
notes.content:
This week we enabled Sovereign Reign: if you beat the game you can now play it with additional difficulty. 

Also fixed several bugs and I am quite happy with the current state of the game. I will now start to focus on a major update and adding additional features, while still fixing any minor bugs that are brought to my attention. Thanks again for checking out the game, excited for the future!

notes.title: 0.2.2 Hotfix
notes.content:
Fixed Static Discharge, The Acacia Strain, and Bob the Builder achievements/unlocks that were not triggering.
Thanks Earth 878 for bringing to my attention

Fixed leaderboard not loading if exactly 64 entries exists
Do not ask why this was a thing, idfk

notes.title: 0.2.0 Week 2 Update - Achievements, Tower Targeting, and Wave Spawning
notes.content:
Rewrote unit distance calculations to provide more accurate tower targeting 
Fixed issue with waves spawning not being cancelled on game end, resulting in a massive amount of enemies spawning on the ship and not moving.
Fixed issue with achievements not triggering
Fixed issue with buttons not being clickable after completing season

Added Additional Achievements inline with unlocks

Moved hero to start of path

notes.title: 0.1.3 Wave spawning Bug Squashed
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where there would be a massive enemies spawning on the ship and not moving. 

Fixed an issue with buttons not being clickable to start the next season

notes.title: 1.0.1 Save Data and Gold Multiplier bug fixes
notes.content:
Fixed the beehive giving 4 extra cards exploit in 1.0.1.
Also Fixed an issue where gold given from things like trust fund and other relics were getting multiplied by enemy increased gold drop rates. 
Also fixed the issue with waves being called early getting multiplied by enemy drop rate.
Corrected description for Might over Magic card

notes.title: 0.1.0 Difficulties!
notes.content: Added the option to play on a Chill difficulty, kept the current difficulty as Challenge. Separate leaderboards for each

notes.title: 0.0.7 Fixes and enhancements
notes.content:
Fix for main menu buttons unavailable after completing game if quit button was spammed

Added ability to toggle pause/play with the spacebar

notes.title: 0.0.6 - Buncha bug fixes
notes.content:
Bugs:
Fixed issue with Trust Fund not applying every season
Fixed issue with Tier 4 Towers being unlocked in later seasons without requiring the Military Academy
Fixed issue with churches not properly applying a 50% reduction to spell cooldown length

Enhancements
You can now drag to move the camera in the upgrades/metaprogression scene

notes.title: 0.0.5 fix framerate not applying
notes.content: Fix to allow capping framerate, added tooltip to clarify that vsync will override it

notes.title: 0.0.4 Bug Fixes - new player.log fetcher
notes.content:
Fixed crash due to completing certain unlock achievements
Added new button for grabbing player's log file and save data, making debugging infinitely easier

Changed metaprogression label to upgrades
Added Escape to leave upgrades panel

notes.title: 0.0.3 Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed issue where buildings unlocked through gameplay were not being made available in game.

Fixed issue where "Feed the Greed" Unlock was not triggering.

Fixed issue with Metaprogression Exit button was hidden on extreme screen aspect ratios.

Enabled Windmill for all save files as the metaprogression way of unlocking was removed

notes.title: 0.0.2 Minor bug fixes
notes.content:
Fixed issue where discounted mage towers were not purchasable unless the player had enough gold to pay the original price.

Fixed null reference leading to blank buttons when abandoning game.
